body:
## Council question

A three-spice mine was emptied last turn and survives into this turn. When are its three spice made available again: in Spice Blow, at collection, or another point? Specify how uncollected spice counts toward its cap.

## Source evidence

Quickstart v0.8 says a fixed amount can be collected from a mine every turn and that it never holds more than that amount. It does not name a replenishment window.

## Draft treatment

The supported surrounding rules are drafted. This detail is marked as awaiting council verification; no answer has been assumed.

## Sources

Quickstart v0.8, Spice Mines.

Part of #1831. Norbert will review these questions together after the full drafting pass. An answer of "I think so, but I need to verify" remains provisional.
title: Dreamrules ruling: When is a spice mine replenished?
